children: The Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund
has repeatedly advanced after sharp increases in its put-call ratio, a pattern that Guilherme Tavares of i3 Invest said was bullish for energy.

Tavares' chart compared XLE's daily price action with its put-call ratio from September 2021 through September 2026. It highlights several periods when the put-call ratio moved sharply above the contrarian "buy" zone, followed by advances in XLE.

The green horizontal line marking the contrarian “buy” zone sits near 0.5 on the put-call ratio scale. Several spikes rose substantially above that level, with some reaching roughly 2 to 2.5, and the chart marks subsequent XLE advances with green arrows.
The chart showed notable spikes around late 2023, 2024, and 2025. Each was followed by an upward move in XLE, forming the historical pattern behind Tavares' bullish view.
XLE has also climbed sharply over the past year, with the ETF's latest price action near the upper end of the range shown on the chart.

The latest put-call ratio reading, however, was below the elevated levels seen during the earlier spikes highlighted in the chart. Tavares marked the current price area with a question mark, leaving the next move open while pointing to the historical relationship between elevated put-call ratios and subsequent strength in XLE.

title: Energy ETF chart flashes bullish signal from put-call ratio
